disposition: ADS-C04 [RATIFY] RATIFIED - ISO family. Owner_decision gate; ratifying it auto-restarts the ADS-C05 governance close (the lane does not land here - the C05 close lands it separately).

rulings.S1_selections: The ISO family per the ADS-C01 section C2 candidate-edition table: ISO 129-1 (dimensioning), ISO 3098 (lettering practice; IBM Plex remains the product typeface per the ratified rendering program - conformance posture per S2), ISO 7200 (title block), ISO 5456 (projection methods) with third-angle projection as the product default, explicitly indicated per drawing (electronics-industry norm, ISO-permitted when indicated). Units: SI (mm presentation over the canonical integer-nm engine). Symbols: IEC 60617 - already ratified (Fork B), carried unchanged. Exact editions = the section C2 candidates as listed; any section C2 ambiguity returns to the PM.
rulings.S2_policy: UNSET-NOT-FABRICATED + EXPLICIT-UNKNOWN. When a selected standard's normative source is unavailable/unlicensed, affected fields/claims render explicitly unknown; nothing is fabricated; the product never refuses to save/work. No conformance claim without F1.
rulings.S3_mechanism: AUTHORIZED - the ADS-C05 governance close authors the numbered decision record for the adopted-standard mechanism (typed engine-owned mutations through the single guarded write path, append-only compensating undo, migration design), design-level, no implementation.
rulings.F1: Carried as the VISIBLE external prerequisite (retained carve-out (c): licensed ISO/ASME normative-text acquisition is a paid external purchase); gates conformance claims only, not this lane.
